rows.summary: TODO_RESOLVE_CONFLICTS.md was already gone. graphify-out/ is no longer tracked (it is in .gitignore, and nothing read it). @napi-rs/canvas is a declared devDependency, so the photo paint tests always run and fail rather than skip if it is missing; file-saver, imported by nothing, is gone. docs/knowledge was checked claim by claim against src/, and tests/unit/knowledge-docs.unit.mjs fails when the stated DATA_VERSION, a named path or a relative link drifts. CI 36021843381 passed; confirmed by the reviewer.

The owner's e-mail, uid and name come from VITE_* env (src/utils/siteOwner.js, documented in .env.example): VITE_DEMO_ACCOUNTS, VITE_CONTACT_EMAIL, VITE_DEV_USER_UID/EMAIL/NAME. A fork that sets none gets no demo account, Terms and Privacy pages that say 'Contact the people who run this site.', and a made-up dev sign-in (dev@example.com). No src file holds a personal mailbox address. The e2e build's demo account is the made-up one in the tracked .env.e2e. The owner's résumé file was already dev-only and in no bundle (vite-plugin-owner-resume.js, tests 24/38), and the app already ran fully without Firebase (firebase.js firebaseEnabled; useAuth cloudAvailable). The README now matches src/: file map, templates, routes (boards, backlog, settings, Your work), scripts, the CI gate and its inputs, and the env vars.
rows.remaining: Owner only: tag v0.1.0; confirm the Terms and Privacy pages match the hosting domain; set the env vars listed in notes on the live site's build BEFORE this reaches master. Also cosmetic: the git-ignored private file is still named private/sairam-resume.json (vite-plugin-owner-resume.js default; it is not in any bundle).

rows.summary: The pushgate.sh the row cites is replaced by .github/workflows/ci.yml, and its claims no longer hold. A failing node test fails its job: steps run under bash -e -o pipefail (defaults.run.shell: bash, ci.yml:59-61) with set -o pipefail and tee (ci.yml:80-84, 127-129). A failed build fails its job (vite build, build job). Browser suites and lint run on every master push and on a full dispatch (the suite/build/playwright/cypress if: conditions start with github.event_name == 'push'; lint has none). The one real gap, skipped tests being hidden, is fixed: the Summary steps of the suite and tests jobs now emit a ::warning:: naming each skipped test. It is additive and non-fatal, and the dispatch inputs are unchanged. Run 36088228020's log shows '##[warning]1 skipped: … # SKIP private/sairam-resume.json is not on this machine'.

Push-gate half: superseded by CI (R2-154); the memory-store pushgate.sh hardening is moot, because the gate is .github/workflows/ci.yml and CLAUDE.md makes CI the only place tests run. Branch templates-ui-audit does not exist on origin (git ls-remote), but its commit 45f4acc ('Phase 1 audit complete') is an ancestor of origin/master, so its content is on the work branch. The stale tracking lines are handed to the coordinator in notes.
rows.remaining: Coordinator: apply the docs/tracking edits listed in notes.
